Sorry, that's on us. Your order ships to Texas, so it should have come with a US plug.

I've put it to the team to send you the correct cord, no return needed for the unit. They're offline until 10am ET today and will confirm to (email hidden)

eu two pin

Got it, EU two pin. That's added to the note.

Don't run it off a travel adapter, an EU supply isn't matched to US 120V, so wait for the correct one rather than risk the unit.

The team sends the right power supply out, nothing to return. They're back at 10am ET and will confirm to (email hidden)
